description: July 2026 marketing-lift series, June-anchored. L_july(d) = L_june(d) + (csv_jul_total(d) - csv_jun_total(d)), where csv_*_total is the marketing team's Total-Paid-DAU forecast interpolated to daily. Carries June's delivered lift plot forward, moved only by the +~139k change in the year-end marketing outlook between the 2026-05-20 (June) and 2026-06-29 (July) CSVs. No April baseline / empirical gap is used (those carried the Iran asymmetry). Pre-launch (< 2026-04-06) = 0.

methodology.framing: june-anchored: prior-cycle lift plot + change in marketing-team CSV outlook
